<!-- docs-drift-check -->
### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **2** package(s): `@objectstack/lint`, `@objectstack/spec`, touching **20** documentable anchor(s). ⚠️ **2** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/spec/api-surface/ui.json`, `packages/spec/export-origins/ui.json`), so the pages documenting them are **NOT COVERED by this run** — this is not a clean bill of health for those files.

**1** hand-written doc(s) NAME something this change touched and may need an implementation-accuracy re-verification:

- `content/docs/ui/views.mdx`  _(via count_empty (symbol, a field of const object COLUMN_SUMMARY_AGGREGATION), count_false (symbol, a field of const object COLUMN_SUMMARY_AGGREGATION; a field of const object COLUMN_SUMMARY_FIELD_TYPES), count_filled (symbol, a field of const object COLUMN_SUMMARY_AGGREGATION), count_true (symbol, a field of const object COLUMN_SUMMARY_AGGREGATION; a field of const object COLUMN_SUMMARY_FIELD_TYPES), percent_empty (symbol, a field of const object COLUMN_SUMMARY_AGGREGATION), percent_filled (symbol, a field of const object COLUMN_SUMMARY_AGGREGATION), count_false (literal, a string literal in ColumnSummarySchema; a string literal in deriveColumnSummary), count_true (literal, a string literal in ColumnSummarySchema; a string literal in deriveColumnSummary))_

⛔ **1** release-owned page(s) also name something this change touched. These are **read-only**:

- `content/docs/releases/v18/18-4.mdx`  _(via deriveColumnSummary (symbol, a top-level function))_

> `content/docs/releases/` is RELEASE-OWNED (AGENTS.md "Documentation Guardrails"): release
> notes are written centrally at release time, and a code PR that edits them is the exact PR
> that guardrail exists to stop. They are still audited — read-only. If one of them is actually
> wrong, **file an issue** or open a dedicated docs-only PR; do not edit it here.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **2** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/spec/api-surface/ui.json`, `packages/spec/export-origins/ui.json`) — pages documenting those are invisible to this run
- **4** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **65** of **247** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **182** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **182**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **59** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **123** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **174** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 170ca481f0aeec14ca06d74ec3d57c654997e698` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `c1bdbfc37703057eb361f6d610f5f1825f54be22` — the merge of head `5107231a969fa2c19b78f8a29e46002c30c16a85` into base `170ca481f0aeec14ca06d74ec3d57c654997e698`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin c1bdbfc37703057eb361f6d610f5f1825f54be22 && git checkout c1bdbfc37703057eb361f6d610f5f1825f54be22
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin 170ca481f0aeec14ca06d74ec3d57c654997e698 5107231a969fa2c19b78f8a29e46002c30c16a85 && git checkout -B drift-repro 170ca481f0aeec14ca06d74ec3d57c654997e698 && git merge --no-ff 5107231a969fa2c19b78f8a29e46002c30c16a85

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 170ca481f0aeec14ca06d74ec3d57c654997e698
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs 170ca481f0aeec14ca06d74ec3d57c654997e698` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## 席位核对 — ACCEPT (L1-b), CI pending

Head-sha: 5107231a96 · read 2026-11-20T22:18Z · full read, base f9097340 (PR 1 #35919 merged) · L1 only, never an L2 (Metadata-protocol `added` → the seat's contract L2 at `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`)

### 维护者速读
- 是/否列（含开关类型）的底部计算菜单新增「「是」的条数」「「否」的条数」，放在最前面；其他类型的列不出现这两项，在元数据里写错类型会被校验直接拒绝。
- 按你 22:01 的裁定 A：没填值的记录不算「否」，算在「空」里，所以 是 + 否 = 已填条数；全空或没有记录时「是」显示 0。
- 服务端没有新的统计函数，用的是平台已经规定好的「布尔按数字求和」，六种数据库都已验证过，所以不涉及数据库改动。
- 没有发现要改的问题。CI 还在跑，绿了 L1 就完成，然后由席位做规格层面的 L2。

### Checked
- **Ruling A (7051689474)** in code:
  - `count_false` = `count_<field>` − `sum_<field>` (the non-null count), never the group count (`deriveColumnSummary`).
  - `count_true` reads `0` when `SUM` answers no value, which covers all-null and no rows.
  - The page fallback counts `=== true` / `=== false`, so a null cell is in neither, the same reading as the server.
  - Pinned on every tier by the rest door's §7b: rows with `approved` null, true and false; per group and over the whole set; `true + false + null = total`; a one-row group reads `count_true` 0, not blank.
- **Premise: no new `AggregationFunction`.** `SUM(boolean)` as the true count rests on ruling #11152. `aggregate-field-type-compatibility.ts` already admits the boolean class in the `sum` row, and the Mongo driver coerces booleans in the arithmetic aggregates (`mongodb-aggregation.ts:788`). No driver push-down change, and SQL-first holds: both nodes are ordinary aggregate nodes on the header / whole-set query.
- **One reading of a row's nodes.** `columnSummaryNodeFunctions(mapping)` feeds the group header compiler (`summaryAggregationNodes`, with the collision check per node), the footer's whole-set query (`wholeSetSummaryNodes`, with the currency check over every node) and the lint. `count_false` asks two nodes (`sum_approved`, `count_approved`); the §7b test pins that exact aggregation list.
- **Type restriction.**
  - `COLUMN_SUMMARY_FIELD_TYPES` holds `{count_true, count_false}` → `boolean`, `toggle`, the same as the spec's `BOOLEAN_AGGREGATE_FIELD_TYPES`. It is read through `isColumnSummaryCompatibleWithFieldType`, which fails closed on shape.
  - The lint refuses the pair on any other type under the existing `list-view-summary-field-type-refused` (an error). It covers the object form `{ type, field }` too, and its explanation entry is updated.
  - The footer menu offers the pair first, and only where that same function allows it. `b-02` shows the menu on a boolean column: Count of Yes, Count of No, then the count family, with no arithmetic.
- **Browser** (`build-seat1/35702-pr2/`): a personal view on Field Zoo picks Count of Yes, which survives a reload (b-11 to b-13), then Count of No (b-14, "No 1"). No unset boolean was in that list, so the null half of ruling A is pinned at the server door and in unit tests, not in a screenshot. That is enough here, because the door is the boundary the figure crosses.
- **Face** (`l1-face`):
  - `Fixes #35702` is right; this is the card's last PR.
  - `Clause-②: yes (widening)`, `Metadata-protocol: added`, `Skills-docs: none` with its reason (no `skills/**` page lists the summary members; checked).
  - Changeset: `minor` on `@objectstack/spec` and `@objectstack/lint`, `patch` on plugin-grid and i18n.
  - The face flags `@objectstack/rest` and `@object-ui/types` with no changeset entry. Both touches are test files only (`list-view-grouping-query-door.test.ts`, `spec-subschema-parity.test.ts`), so nothing they publish changes.
- **Generated artifacts and text.** The `api-surface/ui.json` and `export-origins` rows cover the four new exports. The reference `view.mdx` is regenerated. I read the changeset, `views.mdx`, the reference description and the README sentence by sentence; all are true against the code.
- **i18n.** Four `grid.summary` keys in all 11 packs. zh-Hans 是 / 否 / 「是」的条数 / 「否」的条数. zh-Hant was regenerated in its own commit (5107231a); `zh-hant-generated` decides on green.
- **Regions.** The UI part is only `useColumnSummary.ts` (menu, labels, page fallback) and `useWholeSetSummary.ts`. There is no `ObjectGrid.tsx`, `ListView.tsx` or `data-table.tsx` hunk, so there is no overlap with #35918 or #35910.

### For the L2 (boundary note, not a finding)
- `ColumnSummaryAggregation`'s `derived` row widens `from` from the literal `'count'` to `'count' | 'sum'` and adds `reads`. A published consumer that read `from` as always `'count'` would now see `'sum'` for the two new members. The PR moves every in-repo reader to `columnSummaryNodeFunctions`. Whether that output-type widening is a plain widening is the L2's call on the declaration face.

### Owed
- CI green on `5107231a` (30 pending at read; `TypeScript Type Check` not yet reported); L1 final then.
- Seat: contract L2 at `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` on the green head.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `5107231a969fa2c19b78f8a29e46002c30c16a85`
Local-runs: none
Scope: packages/spec/src/ui/view-grouping-query.ts, packages/spec/src/ui/view.zod.ts + packages/lint/src/validate-list-view-field-refs.ts, packages/lint/src/rule-explanations.ts, ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/useWholeSetSummary.ts, ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/useColumnSummary.ts

Read at 2026-11-20T22:44Z: card #35702 (body and all seven comments, rulings 7045525672 and 7051689474 included), PR #35944 (body, the 30-file list, the net diff against `main`), and the check-runs on the head. The remainder of the diff (tests, the eleven locale packs, docs, generated baselines, the changeset prose) is the lane seat's ACCEPT at `TIER_DEFAULT`.

### ① Derived judgments

- `ColumnSummarySchema` accept-set: gains `count_true` and `count_false`, nothing removed or renamed. Right: a widening, and the card's 要做的 names exactly these two.
- `ListColumn.summary` (string form and the `{ type, field }` form) accepts the two members by reference. Right; `Metadata-protocol: added` is the matching line.
- `ColumnSummaryAggregation`, the `derived` arm: `from` widens from the literal `count` to `count | sum`, and a required `reads` tuple is added. Right as built: it is an output type that only the table constructs, and `from` stays the first of `reads`, so a consumer still asking the one `from` node gets a correct `count_true` and an `undefined` (no figure) `count_false`, never a wrong number.
- New public exports `ColumnSummaryDerivedSource`, `columnSummaryNodeFunctions`, `COLUMN_SUMMARY_FIELD_TYPES`, `isColumnSummaryCompatibleWithFieldType`: all four are in `api-surface/ui.json` and `export-origins/ui.json`. Right.
- `deriveColumnSummary` / `ColumnSummaryValue`: the two members read back as a number. Right; they never answer `null` (a `SUM` that answered no value reads 0).
- Lint accept-set: `list-view-summary-field-type-refused` now also refuses the two NEW members over a non-boolean field. Right, and not a narrowing: no declaration that parsed before this PR is newly refused.
- Gate verdicts are the head's check-runs: every run concluded success or skipped (Test Core 1-10, Test UI 1-16, TypeScript Type Check, Type Check UI, Lint and Repo Gates, Check Changeset, Spec property liveness, Governed Surface Queue Guard, Build Core / UI / Docs, Live E2E UI, Dogfood Regression Gate). None failed.

### ② Semver level

Clause-②: yes (widening) — on the PR body and in `.changeset/35702-boolean-yes-no-counts.md`, with `Metadata-protocol: added` on both. `@objectstack/spec` minor (two authorable enum members, four new exports) and `@objectstack/lint` minor (a new refusal that only the new members can earn) match what the diff publishes. `@object-ui/plugin-grid` and `@object-ui/i18n` at patch follow the repo's standing practice for UI feature changesets (the sibling list-page changesets on `main` do the same). Check Changeset is green on the head. Right level.

### ③ Boundary flags

- Open fork from the claim (does an unset boolean count as 否): answered by maintainer ruling 7051689474, option A. The tree builds A: `count_false` is `count_FIELD − sum_FIELD`, never the record count; a null cell is in neither count; an all-null or empty set reads 0 for 是. Checked in `deriveColumnSummary`, in the page fallback (`=== true` / `=== false`) and in the docs strings.
- `open_questions`: none carried on this PR. PR 1's report carried `[]`.
- Disclosed by the dev, not in scope: the edit form draws an unset boolean as an unticked box. The ruling records it as outside the ruling. No action here.
- Disclosed by the dev: the group header compiler reads no field types, so an unlinted `count_true` over a number answers that column's sum. Accepted as the same tier the aggregate × field-type pairs are judged at; see N4 for the one path the lint does not cover.
- SQL push-down (Prime Directive 5): holds. Both counts are aggregate nodes in the ONE existing aggregate query (`SUM(field)` and `COUNT(field)`, deduplicated with any `sum` / `count_empty` on the same field). No id materialisation, no in-app join, no new `AggregationFunction`, no driver change. The page fallback is the pre-existing no-aggregate-door path, labelled as the page's.
- Body claim that the tree does not carry, for the seat to correct before the maintainer reads it (a body edit, the head does not move): 维护者速读 says 「分组时每组标题上也能显示这两个数」. The spec compiler and `deriveColumnSummary` do serve the two members on a group header row, and the REST door test covers that. The console does not draw them there: its group headers read `schema.aggregations` in the grid's own six-member vocabulary (`useGroupedData.ts` `SERVER_SUMMARY`: sum, count, avg, min, max, count_distinct), not the columns' `summary`, and this PR does not change that. In the console the two counts appear in the footer only.

### ④ Design judgment

No must-fix, no should-fix.

`packages/spec/src/ui/view.zod.ts` — holds. The two members are the card's, the jsdoc and the `.describe` state ruling 7051689474 (a null cell is neither, 是 + 否 = filled), and both rows exist in `COLUMN_SUMMARY_AGGREGATION` as the file's own rule demands. First consumer (`useColumnSummary` / `useWholeSetSummary`) reads them through the spec's table and read-back.

`packages/spec/src/ui/view-grouping-query.ts` — holds. Tried to break it on:
- the ground: `sum` over `boolean` and `toggle` is in `AGGREGATE_FIELD_TYPE_COMPATIBILITY` on `main` on the authority of ruling #11152, pinned by `AGGREGATION_CASES` (`sum(flag)=3`), with the Postgres int cast in `driver-sql`. The claim cited is the claim the tree makes.
- nulls: `SUM` and `COUNT(field)` both skip nulls, so `count − sum` is exactly the explicit-false count. `sum === null` reads 0 true; a missing `sum` column reads `undefined`; a missing or null `count` column reads `undefined` for `count_false` rather than a guess.
- the compiler loop: every node of `reads` passes the alias-collision check before it is added; the fieldless `count` still rides the group count; a `sum` summary on the same field shares the node.
- the multi-level fold: `sum_FIELD` and `count_FIELD` both fold exactly, so both members do.
- the field-type table: `isColumnSummaryCompatibleWithFieldType` is fail-closed on shape, guarded by `hasOwnProperty`, and the pin test holds the list equal to `BOOLEAN_VALUE_TYPES`.

Implementing files, against the contract:
- `packages/lint/src/validate-list-view-field-refs.ts` — agrees. A restricted member is resolved before the aggregate-kind early return and judged by the spec's table; the four `COUNT(field)` members still return unjudged; both carriers (list view columns, `object-grid` page columns) share the one function. `rule-explanations.ts` says the same.
- `ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/useWholeSetSummary.ts` — agrees. It asks `columnSummaryNodeFunctions(mapping)`, the same reading as the compiler, so the footer's whole-set question and the group header's cannot differ.
- `ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/useColumnSummary.ts` — agrees. The menu offers the two members only where the spec's table allows; the page fallback counts only a real `true` / `false`, which is the boolean cell's own reading on `main` (`BooleanCellRenderer`: a non-boolean is "No value"), so page and server agree on a null cell; both members sit in the plain-count family, so no currency or percent formatting touches them.

Nits (no effect on correctness or the contract; none is fixed on this head — accepted deviations or one follow-up card):
- N1 (nit) — `view-grouping-query.ts`: the long jsdoc that documents `ColumnSummaryAggregation` now sits above the new `ColumnSummaryDerivedSource` declaration, with that type's own one-line jsdoc between them. `ColumnSummaryAggregation` itself carries no doc comment any more. Move the new type above the block.
- N2 (nit) — `view-grouping-query.ts`, Multi-level grouping paragraph: it derives `count_false` "from the folded sum" alone; it also reads the folded `count_FIELD`. The table above it is right.
- N3 (nit) — `validate-list-view-field-refs.ts`: the refusal message ends "here it would print a total as a count". That is true over a numeric field. Over text, or a `formula`, the door refuses the `SUM` itself and nothing is printed. The refusal and the rule id are right; only the reason is too narrow.
- N4 (nit) — `view.zod.ts` jsdoc says the two members "are refused over any other field type" without saying by whom. The refusal is the authoring lint's; the schema, the compiler and the footer hook accept the pair. A declaration that reaches the grid unlinted (not measured here: whether a personal-view write passes the lint) would draw a number column's whole-set total under 是, while the page fallback draws 0. A draw-time check of `isColumnSummaryCompatibleWithFieldType` in `useScopedColumnSummary` would close it; follow-up card, not this PR.
- N5 (nit) — `view-grouping-query.ts`: the `reads` tuples and `BOOLEAN_SUMMARY_FIELD_TYPES` are readonly in type only; the outer tables are frozen, the inner arrays are not (the `AGGREGATE_FIELD_TYPE_COMPATIBILITY` rows are frozen).

L2 adoption and landing · 2026-11-20T22:50Z · The seat adopts the isolated contract-review record 7052446592 on head `5107231a` (served at `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`, posted with tier evidence, owed by the published-schema face `packages/spec/src/ui/**` and `Clause-②: yes (widening)`).
